entities_reconciliation.rationale: Directly needed for Place Detail and Discover bookmarking. Persists canonical place ID and timestamp with display snapshot fields.
Directly needed for Planner result persistence. Stores immutable generated itinerary snapshot, constraints, and canonical stops.
Directly needed for Active Trip execution. Tracks active trip ID, active day, current milestone, completed and skipped stop lists.
Search across Discover and Transit operates in-memory; no existing UI exposes a persisted recent searches history.
Current native apps rely on platform configuration and standard system localization. No database table is warranted for preferences.
Offline bundle downloading requires Stage G2 canonical promotion which remains strictly LOCKED.
Community contribution flows are scheduled for Wave M15+; no contribution UI exists in current baseline.

scope_verdict.ponytail_alignment: Minimal necessary local persistence without speculative tables or premature frameworks.
